content: REQUIRED DOCUMENTATION FOR BOT: 1. PRD. 2. Persona & Conversation Design. 3. NLP Model Spec & Intent Mapping. 4. API Contracts. 5. DB Schema & Conversation Logs. 6. Bot Security & Auth. 7. DFDs. 8. Privacy Policy (GDPR/HIPAA). 9. CI/CD. 10. DR & Fallback. 11. Incident Response. 12. Runbooks. 13. Audit Reports. 14. Dependency Analysis.
